messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: HIGH - Node gpu-node-13 reporting DiskPressure and kubelet eviction threshold breached. Affected: modelcache + serve runtime pods. thread_ts=1765432109

maria: multiple evictions observed on gpu-node-13. modelcache pods restarting; logs show ENOSPC on checkpoint writes and large log churn. :rotating_light:

ajay: confirm `kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-13 -o wide` -> several modelcache-* pods Evicted, RestartCount > 4.

tim: pulling node disk metrics now. /var/lib/kubelet and /srv/modelcache at 97-99% used. iostat: intense write I/O sustained for 10m.

devon: runtime stack: redwood-runtime:v3 + modelcache sidecar + logging sidecar (fluentd). Hypothesis: canary model B enabled verbose checkpointing + debug logs -> runaway writes.

lisa: any GPU errors? seeing CUDA faults in pod logs?

maria: some CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS entries align with restarts, but primary failure chain looks like ENOSPC on checkpoint write -> modelcache exits -> runtime restart -> spike in logs.

sre-bot: Created incident INC-2026-042 for gpu-node-13 disk pressure and pod evictions; paging oncall.

ajay: grab recent modelcache pod tail:
```
[2026-03-15T17:01:02Z] ERROR  write checkpoint failed: write /srv/modelcache/checkpoints/m-xyz.chk: no space left on device
[2026-03-15T17:01:03Z] INFO   attempting graceful shutdown
[2026-03-15T17:01:03Z] FATAL  runtime panic: out of memory
```

tim: node dmesg shows repeated ext4 ENOSPC and "inode table full" warnings.

devon: listing top dirs:
```
# du -sh /srv/modelcache/* | sort -h
700M  /srv/modelcache/model-a
12G   /srv/modelcache/model-b
38G   /srv/modelcache/checkpoints
```
model-b's checkpoint rotation wasn't pruning; canary deployed yesterday enabled frequent incremental checkpoints.

lisa: customer impact: routes using model-b show elevated 5xxs and latency. Tenants affected: tenant-42 (high), tenant-87 (med). Frontend routed to fallbacks where available but capacity stressed.

maria: short mitigation plan:
- cordon gpu-node-13
- drain non-critical pods to reduce pressure
- purge oldest checkpoints (>7d) after archiving to NFS
- reduce canary log level and checkpoint frequency
- restart logging sidecars with smaller buffers
- reroute heavy tenants off the congested pool

ajay: running `kubectl cordon gpu-node-13` -> cordoned.

maria: safely rsyncing stale checkpoints to archival then removing. Commands used:
```
find /srv/modelcache/checkpoints -type f -mtime +7 -print0 | xargs -0 ls -lh
rsync --remove-source-files /srv/modelcache/checkpoints/ /nfs/archival/checkpoints/
```

devon: lowering canary logs: `kubectl set env deploy/model-b LOG_LEVEL=info` applied to deployment. Also adjusting checkpoint TTL config in canary config.

tim: purging stale files freed ~42GB. Node free space rose to ~25-28%. kubelet DiskPressure cleared briefly but flapping continues.

sre-bot: Note: several pods used emptyDir local volumes; `--delete-local-data` needed when draining. Be careful for stateful pieces.

lisa: what about immediate customer comms? Should accounts/CSM be notified?

maria: I posted initial impact summary to #customer-impact and pinged CSMs: impact window ~17:00-17:22 UTC. Tenant-42 errors back to baseline after reroute; tenant-87 recovering.

ajay: draining node fully now: `kubectl drain gpu-node-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` - in progress.

devon: drain completed; most serve pods rescheduled on pool; autoscaler spun up 2 extra nodes to absorb load.

tim: GPU logs show CUDA errors tied to mid-request restarts — likely secondary. No persistent GPU driver faults.

lisa: we routed tenant-42 to dedicated-dpool-2 as hotfix; tenant-42 error rate normalized.

maria: creating JIRA INC-2026-042 and assigning action items. Drafting customer-facing note for CSM review.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Node cordoned/drained, space reclaimed, logs lowered, checkpoints archived. No persistent data loss beyond ephemeral cache.

devon: post-incident actions:
- add auto-prune TTL/N retention to model-b checkpointer
- add alert on modelcache dir usage at 70% and 85% with runbook link
- ensure canary defaults not to debug-level logging that writes to local disk
- evaluate moving checkpoints to NFS-backed storage for large models
- add storage pressure chaos test for modelcache in staging

maria: runbook note added: `DiskPressure on gpu-node-* -> cordon -> drain -> archive & purge modelcache/checkpoints -> reduce log level -> verify free space >20% -> uncordon` saved to oncall-runbook.

ajay: reprovisioning gpu-node-13 tonight; marking incident as mitigated but will monitor for 2 hours.

maria: final checks at 17:37 UTC: no new evictions, traffic stabilized. last_message_ts=1765432185

deploy-bot: Deploy: rolling restart of model-b to pick up config changes completed at 17:35 UTC.

ops-manager: Good response. Postmortem should include updated monitor thresholds and the checkpoint retention fix. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident resolved: mitigated. Postmortem owners: maria, devon, tim.
